powershell.exe -Command "bash .\\compile.sh; Get-ChildItem executable*; python -m py_compile .\\xsv_port.py; @'
import subprocess,pathlib,sys,os
root=pathlib.Path('.'); ref=root.joinpath('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
ours=[sys.executable,str(root/'xsv_port.py')]
p=root/'probe'; p.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
files={
'basic.csv':b'h1,h2\\na,2\\nb,1\\n',
'select.csv':b'h1,h2,h[]3,h4,h1\\na,b,c,d,e\\n',
'freq.csv':b'h1,h2\\na,z\\na,y\\na,y\\nb,z\\n\"\",z\\n(NULL),x\\n',
'table.csv':b'h1,h2,h3\\nabcdefg,a,a\\na,abc,z\\n',
'stats.csv':b'h\\n1\\n2\\n3\\n',
'quote.csv':b'a,b\\n\"x,y\",\"q\"\"z\"\\n'}
for n,b in files.items(): (p/n).write_bytes(b)
cases=[
['count',str(p/'basic.csv')],['count','-n',str(p/'basic.csv')],
['headers',str(p/'basic.csv')],['headers','--just-names',str(p/'basic.csv')],
['select','h1[1]-h1[0]',str(p/'select.csv')],['select','"'!"h[]3"[0]'"',str(p/'select.csv')],
['slice','-s','1','-l','1',str(p/'basic.csv')],['slice','--index','0',str(p/'basic.csv')],
['search','"'^a'"',str(p/'basic.csv')],['search','"'^a'"','--select','h2',str(p/'basic.csv')],
['sort',str(p/'basic.csv')],['sort','-N','--select','h2',str(p/'basic.csv')],['sort','-R','-n',str(p/'basic.csv')],
['table',str(p/'table.csv')],['table','-c','3',str(p/'table.csv')],
['fmt','--out-delimiter','\\\\t',str(p/'quote.csv')],['fmt','--quote-always',str(p/'quote.csv')],['fmt','--ascii',str(p/'quote.csv')],
['stats','--everything',str(p/'stats.csv')],
['frequency','--limit','1',str(p/'freq.csv')],['frequency','--limit','0','--select','h2',str(p/'freq.csv')],
]
fail=0
for args in cases:
 a=subprocess.run([ref,*args],capture_output=True)
 b=subprocess.run([*ours,*args],capture_output=True)
 ok=(a.returncode,a.stdout,a.stderr)==(b.returncode,b.stdout,b.stderr)
 print(('OK  ' if ok else 'FAIL'),args)
 if not ok:
  fail+=1; print(' ref',a.returncode,repr(a.stdout),repr(a.stderr)); print(' our',b.returncode,repr(b.stdout),repr(b.stderr))
print('failures',fail)
'@ | python -"
